hook.text: A Formula 1 pit crew can change four tires in under two seconds.

buildup.text: Cross-industry transfer takes a proven solution from one domain and applies it to a completely different one.

discovery.text: The key is spotting the shared structure: both pit stops and surgeries are high-stakes, time-critical handoff sequences.

twist.text: Industries rarely look outside their own walls. Hospitals study hospitals. Banks study banks.

climax.text: Deliberately study unrelated industries. Ask: who has solved a structurally similar problem? Import their method.

punchline.text: The best solution may come from a completely different field.

quiz.question: What enabled the hospital to learn from a Formula 1 pit crew?
options: Both involve high-stakes, time-critical handoff sequences
